description: Spec 005 D6's two primer sentences (passing results are silent; what a revision is) added after the run-tests-yourself sentence, in every bundle that inlines the primer.

patch.find: "Run tests yourself only when no daemon is validating, when results are unknown, or when the repository's own gate requires it.",
patch.replace:
"Run tests yourself only when no daemon is validating, when results are unknown, or when the repository's own gate requires it.",
    "Passing results are silent: a SQUEAL message means a check changed, so silence after an edit is not a lost message.",
    "A revision is Squeal's number for each saved change to this worktree's files; every result names the revision it ran at, and a header names the files its revision changed.",
